snippet.title: Petunia's Purgatory New Trailer - Launching July 16th
snippet.description:
Petunia's Purgatory is an idle farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Unlike other Idler games, your desktop becomes part of the experience as the farm keeps growing, waiting, and quietly getting worse.

Grow unusual crops, care for your farm, and make offerings to something lurking in the barn.

Keep Petunia sane as her reality begins to slip... before her hallucinations spill onto your screen.
